title: Grand Theft Auto VI
summary: Rockstar Games lists Grand Theft Auto VI for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S with a November 19, 2026 release date. PlayStation's store page lists a PS5 version and a PS5 Pro Enhanced version (PSSR upscaling and ray-traced shadows) and says it will only be playable on PS5 consoles, not PS4. We found no PC version announced on Rockstar's official page.

sources.label: Rockstar Games: Grand Theft Auto VI (official page)
sources.note: Shows 'Coming November 19, 2026', platform badges for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, Standard and Ultimate editions, a 'Plays best on PlayStation 5' badge, and a pre-load notice for November 19.

sources.label: PlayStation: Grand Theft Auto VI (US store page)
sources.note: Lists 'Available on PS5' with 'PS5 Pro Enhanced'; FAQ says 'released for PlayStation 5 and PS5 Pro on November 19, 2026' and 'will only be playable on PlayStation 5 consoles. It will not be available for PlayStation 4'; PS5 Pro Enhanced = PSSR and ray-traced shadows, compatible display required.
